build_docker_image: build a docker image by running docker build in the project root directory
test_docker_build: test that the docker image builds successfully using unittest and subprocess
use_cd_context_manager: use the cd context manager to temporarily change the working directory in a with block
create_cd_context_manager: create a context manager class that changes directories and restores the original path on exit
run_subprocess_docker_build: run a docker build command via subprocess.check_output from within a changed directory
